newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - IBM trades higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - IBM trades higher.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp and Telebras SA were virtually the only stocks moving in moderate trade during the after-hours session, dealers said Monday.
"It (IBM) is the most interesting one," said one of them, referring to the after-hours market in general.
The computer company's stock was trading at 173-1/4 against a close of 171-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Meanwhile, Brazilian telecommunications company Telebras was at 127-5/8 from a close of 127-7/8.
During normal trading hours, IBM reached a 52-week high and came close to a historic high.
The after-hours session was remained calm otherwise.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 6,500 shares against 70,400 on Friday, while session two had 2.2 million against 965,300.
